modules.title: Introduction to Nkọwa (Adjectives and Adverbs)
modules.html:
Words used to describe nouns and verbs in Igbo. This section covers introduction to nkọwa (adjectives and adverbs).

Key points

  • Study the meaning, main features and examples of nkọwa (adjectives and adverbs).
  • Be able to explain nkọwa (adjectives and adverbs) in your own words and give examples.
  • Practise the 50-question quiz for this topic until you score well without notes.

Worked examples

Q: Mkpụrụedemede asụsụ Igbo dị ole?
A: Iri atọ na isii — The Standard Igbo alphabet (Abidịị) consists of 36 letters.

Q: Olee n'ime ndị a bụ udaume mfe (Light vowels)?
A: a, ị, ọ, ụ — The light vowels in Igbo (udaume mfe) are a, ị, ọ, and ụ, which follow the vowel harmony rule.

examples.q: Olee n'ime ndị a bụ udaume mfe (Light vowels)?

quiz.q: Mkpụrụedemede asụsụ Igbo dị ole?
quiz.solution: The Standard Igbo alphabet (Abidịị) consists of 36 letters.

quiz.q: Olee n'ime ndị a bụ udaume mfe (Light vowels)?
quiz.solution: The light vowels in Igbo (udaume mfe) are a, ị, ọ, and ụ, which follow the vowel harmony rule.

quiz.q: Udaume ole dị n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Igbo language has 8 vowels divided into two groups of four (Light and Heavy).

quiz.q: Olee akaraolu (Tone mark) a na-asụpe 'à'?
quiz.solution: The grave accent (`) represents the low tone (akaraolu ala) in Igbo.

quiz.q: Ịlụ nwanyị n'ala Igbo na-amalite site n'ikụ aka n'ọnụ ụzọ nke a kpọrọ _____.
quiz.solution: The first formal step in Igbo marriage is 'Ịjụ ajụjụ' (inquiry/knocking), where the groom's family visits to state their intentions.

quiz.q: Kedu onye n'ala Igbo na-arụ ọrụ ikpe ikpe na idozi okwu n'obodo n'oge gboo?
quiz.solution: The titled elders (Nze na Ọzọ) and the council of elders were the primary judicial authorities in traditional Igbo society.

quiz.q: Olee dọkịta na-agba afa iji mara ihe na-eme n'ụwa ndị mmụọ?
quiz.solution: A 'Dibia afa' is a diviner who communicates with the spiritual realm to find causes of problems.

quiz.q: Kedu onye dere akwụkwọ 'Isi Akwu Dara n'Ala'?
quiz.solution: Tony Ubesie is the author of this classic Igbo novel.

quiz.q: Olee mgbe a na-asị mmadụ 'Ka chi fo'?
quiz.solution: 'Ka chi fo' is 'Good night', used when parting in the evening.

quiz.q: Mgbochiume ole dị n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Out of the 36 letters, 8 are vowels and 28 are consonants (mgbochiume).

quiz.q: Olee onye dere akwụkwọ 'Omenụkọ'?
quiz.solution: Pita Nwana wrote the first Igbo novel, 'Omenụkọ'.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Irony' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Nkwuọtọ is the literary term for irony.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka a na-eji amata onye nwere echichi 'Ozo'?
options: Okpu mme mme na mpị nzu
quiz.solution: Ozo titled men are known by their red caps and elephant tusks.

quiz.q: Ònye dere 'Omenuko'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Pita Nwana.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Father'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Nna.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'God'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Chukwu.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Teacher'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Onye nkuzi.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ear'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ntị.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Mgbochiume'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Consonant.

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Abụ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Song/Poem.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ekpere'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Prayer.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Anya'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Eye.

quiz.q: Menene 'Wakilin Suna'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Pronoun.

quiz.q: Menene ake kira da 'Bikin Suna'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Naming Ceremony.

quiz.q: Menene 'Gishiri'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Salt.

quiz.q: Menene 'Rana'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Sun/Day.

quiz.q: Kedu n'ime ndị a bụ akụkụ ahụ mmadụ?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Imi.

quiz.q: Kedu ebe a na-asụ asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: South-East.

quiz.q: Ụdaume ole ka a na-asụ n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Asatọ.

quiz.q: Nwa nwaanyị mbụ a mụrụ n'ezinaụlọ ka a na-akpọ...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Ada.

quiz.q: Kedu onye na-achị obodo n'asụsụ Igbo ugbu a?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Eze/Igwe.
